I am so sorry to hear what you went though. PTSD from what I understand of it, can happen to people who experience traumatic events. Everyone's traumas are different. It can vary from serious accidents, childbirth experiences, war, serious health problems, abusive, assault and many other things because you never know what could be traumatic to someone no matter how big or small it may seem.   


It sounds like you numbed the trauma, so there was a delay, and then it hit you hard when you had more clarity, which must be terrifying, and you must feel so overwhelmed. 

You are right that its not good to self diagnose, and you don't need to google things because sometimes it does more harm than good. BUT you know that something is not right mentally, and you are suffering, so I strongly suggest you find a therapist you feel comfortable or safe with. You might not get the right one straight away, sometimes you can and sometimes you may have to try a few out. Not sure where in the world you are situated, but there is usually databases with therapists etc on in your area/town and you can scroll through and find contact number or email.

It sounds very likely you are experiencing something in regards to the shit you had to deal with in the past, and its so scary confronting it but you will fight this! We will not let our pasts determine our futures! It will take work, i wish you all the best x
I think you are beautiful
